title: Shared Interactive Knowledge-Tree UI Components
description: The frontend module shall provide shared, actor-agnostic components for interactive knowledge-tree node review and live status updates.
rationale: Both the student build flow and the admin draft authoring flow must render knowledge-tree nodes grouped by layer with live SSE status, HITL approve/feedback/regenerate controls, per-node chat, and layer-expand prompts. Sharing a single component set (Vue 3 TreeView, NodeCard, LayerExpandControl, and the useNodeEvents composable backed by the G2-S3 HTTP/SSE API) eliminates duplication and ensures both flows behave consistently.
